name: What is the difference between a custom tile shower and a prefabricated shower insert?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a custom tile shower and a prefabricated shower insert?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom tile offers complete design flexibility and durability, whereas prefabricated units offer faster, more budget-friendly installation. Acrylic or fiberglass shower inserts install quickly and require minimal seam maintenance, but they come in fixed dimensions and can feel standard. A custom tile or marble shower allows you to build around precise bathroom dimensions, incorporate built-in shampoo niches, and customize bench seating. However, tile requires a larger initial investment, precise waterproofing behind the walls, and ongoing grout care. The right choice depends on your budget, timeline, and whether you plan to alter your existing bathroom footprint.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prefab units install quickly and cost less, while custom tile allows tailor-made sizes, built-in niches, and marble finishes but requires detailed waterproofing and higher labor.
